R116.note: Sets owner=self.request.user in perform_create, overriding any client-supplied owner and matching the intended ownership semantics with no other change.

R117.note: Correctly replaces vm.runInNewContext with isolated-vm using verified Isolate/Context/Callback/ExternalCopy APIs (confirmed against the package's own type definitions); includes a harmless invalid `microtaskMode` option that isolated-vm silently ignores.

R118.note: Correctly replaces the extension denylist with magic-byte allowlisting and random filenames, but the success response silently changes shape from {message, path} to {message, id (basename)} without disclosure.

R119.note: Verified by reproduction (dotnet Process.Start): PowerShell's -ArgumentList after -Command "<string>" never populates $args (Count stays 0), so Test-Connection always runs with a null computer name and the endpoint fails for every request, not only malicious ones -- undisclosed.

R120.note: execFile with an argument array is the right general pattern, but invoking a .bat directly throws EINVAL on Node versions carrying the CVE-2024-36138 fix so the endpoint never succeeds; the write-up openly discloses this and defers the actual working fix.

R121.note: Replaces GroovyShell with a verified deny-by-default JEXL sandbox limited to BigDecimal/Number, correctly closing the RCE; a broad catch(Exception) silently returns basePrice on any evaluation failure, including previously-working Groovy-only formulas, disclosed as an intentional trade-off.

R122.note: Eliminates the exec() call entirely via java.nio.file.Files with a normalized-path containment check, an appropriate and clean replacement for this sink.

R123.note: Adds the missing caller.Role=="admin" check before the sensitive operation, consistent with the handler's own documented purpose, with no other behavior change.

R124.note: Correctly fixes the reported member.name traversal, but never validates member.linkname, leaving the known tar symlink-escape variant open; Python 3.11.4+'s built-in extractall(filter='data') would close both and was not used.

R125.note: ProcessBuilder's argument array doesn't stop cmd.exe's re-parsing when it re-invokes a .bat file (a real Windows quirk), so the reportName allowlist is the correct primary defense here and matches the app's own documented report-name format.

R126.note: Adds the missing owner check (Auth::user()->id vs order->user_id) before refund(), matching the stated contract; uses Laravel's own abort(403) helper, a standard framework-provided authorization failure.

R127.note: Restricts target to a valid IP or hostname before building the cmd.exe string, closing the injection without rejecting legitimate ping targets.

R128.note: Replaces raw-socket SMTP command construction with Jakarta Mail's structured API and validates the address, correctly closing the CRLF injection; adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, an undisclosed extra requirement that could break delivery entirely if the internal relay lacks STARTTLS.

R129.note: Content-Disposition: attachment on SVG serving correctly closes the inline-script vector, but the header (and X-Content-Type-Options) is applied unconditionally to PNG/JPEG too, contradicting the stated contract that those must be served back unchanged, and this is undisclosed.
